session.demoTopic: the My Work page and step documents

statusNote: The My Work page shipped to the test environment this week. Feedback that repeats last week's approved updates is left out.

decisions.title: Heat map: now or later?
decisions.body: NW-104 keeps reporting to preset filters for the MVP. Dana asked for a heat map of at-risk work on the timeline.
decisions.rec: Proposed: future enhancement. The overdue filter covers the MVP.

feedback.label: Filter by several statuses
feedback.summary: Step owners can filter their steps by more than one status at once, across all their clients.
feedback.t: Asked to see every not-started and in-progress step together, without blocked ones, so they know what they can work on today.

feedback.label: Team view for every member
feedback.summary: Everyone on a team can see their teammates' steps, so they can cover absences.
feedback.t: The team uses a shared mailbox today so anyone can cover for someone who is away. Asked for a team view open to every member, not only the lead.

feedback.label: Risk heat map
feedback.summary: The project timeline highlights at-risk and coming-due work before a date slips.
feedback.t: Asked whether the timeline will show what is at risk or coming due, so attention goes there first.

feedback.label: Upload from the step
feedback.summary: Step owners attach a file on the step and it lands in the client's folder.
feedback.t: Liked that the upload went straight to the client folder. Asked that this stays the only way files get there.
feedback.covered: the step upload shown in this week's demo

US-03.title: See my work across clients
US-03.build: My Work page built: by-status and by-client views.
US-03.desc:
## Description

As a step owner, I can open one view of everything assigned to me.

## Acceptance criteria

* By default I only see the steps I am assigned to.
* I can see which of my steps are overdue.

## Open questions

* Should this be the default home page?

## User persona

Step owner

US-07.title: See my team's queue
US-07.desc:
## Description

As a team lead, I can see every client my team is on and assign my people against it.

## Acceptance criteria

* I can see every client my team is assigned to in one list.
* I can assign a step to a named person on my team.

## User persona

Team lead

US-09.title: Attach a document to a step
US-09.build: Upload to the client folder demoed.
US-09.desc:
## Description

As a step owner, I can attach the document my step produced, and it lands in the client's folder.

## Acceptance criteria

* Dropping a file on the step uploads it to the client's folder.
* Re-uploading a file with the same name creates a new version.

## User persona

Step owner

edits.txt: I can filter my steps by more than one status at once, across all my clients or for one client.
Should the steps I can act on sort by due date or by how much downstream work they unblock? Alex to propose, Tomas to confirm.
Every member of a team can open the team view and see each teammate's assigned steps, so they can cover absences.
The team uses a shared mailbox today so teammates can cover each other. Steps go to one person in the tool, so this view replaces the mailbox (Dana, 15 Jan).

edits.title: See at-risk and coming-due work on the timeline
edits.txt:
## Description

As an implementation lead, I can see on the project timeline which steps are at risk and which are coming due, so I can act before a date slips.

## Acceptance criteria

* The timeline highlights overdue, at-risk and coming-due steps.
* I can see the highlight for one client or across all my clients.

## Open questions

* What counts as at risk? Confirm with the PMs.

## User persona

Implementation lead
Uploading through the step is the only way files reach the client folder; direct edits in the folder are blocked.
